disposition_rationale: The positive core is sound and reproduces exactly: two governed source-free canary rules commit to exact M3 result-contract bindings over closed objective-world schemas, both evaluate SUPPORTED through the UNMODIFIED adopted M3 seam, replay is stable, and every hostile construction fails closed somewhere. The frozen semantic-FAMILY ceiling holds at author_governed_rule and at M3. But the commission's property E fails and property B fails, and the substrate's exclusions of scalars, strong nouns and actor semantics are properties of the two canary INSTANCES rather than of the MACHINERY: the generic constructors author, register and positively evaluate material carrying person-state schema roles, actor-desire participant labels, DOMINATION/HEGEMONY/CAPITAL relation kinds, numeric scalar leaves, and an unsatisfiable OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED mode. The authored interaction relation-kind vocabulary is exactly the set of premises that adopted V556 architecture (TD_R03 section 5 / gate G14) forbids from constituting an interaction relation. These are bounded, repairable defects on the authoring/ontology surface, not a failure of the adopted seam.

allowed_disposition_not_selected.ACCEPT_V556_POSITIVE_SUBSTRATE__TOPOLOGY: rejected: property E and property B fail, and the interaction relation-kind vocabulary contradicts the non-inference law of the V556 architecture of record
allowed_disposition_not_selected.V556_SUBSTRATE_PARTIAL__TRANCHE_CEILING_: rejected as the primary label: the one-rule-per-family restriction is lawful and registry-local; the surviving ceiling findings (unadopted role subset, dead OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED parameter, unenforced registry family check) are secondary documentation/robustness repairs
allowed_disposition_not_selected.V556_SUBSTRATE_QUALIFICATION_FAILURE: rejected as too strong: the adopted seam fails closed on every hostile construction; no unauthorised material can produce a positive object at evaluation, and no implementation file was changed
allowed_disposition_not_selected.MATERIAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT: rejected: the tension between H-B's recommended coexistence-array shape and TD_R03's non-inference law is resolvable within H-B's own shape by choosing governed relation kinds that are not forbidden premises; no blocking authority conflict

findings.summary: author_result_contract_binding, author_governed_rule and V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build perform no schema/contract validation, so an open schema with a person-state role is registrable as GOVERNED_RULES_PRESENT; refusal happens only at M3 evaluation (INTEGRITY_FAILURE). Probes P1a/P1b/P13.

participant role labels, enum values and primitive types are unconstrained: ACTOR_DESIRE/ACTOR_BELIEF role labels and a DOMINATION relation kind both produce SUPPORTED positive V556 objects; a numeric 'pressure_magnitude' leaf is authorable. Probes P2, P19, P9.

PERMITTED_RELATION_KINDS maps 1:1 onto the coexistence / shared-channel / parallel-occurrence premises that TD_R03 section 5 and gate G14 declare can never constitute an F1 relation. The only governed interaction vocabulary inverts the adopted non-inference law.

the topology canary mandates one shared-channel dyad (missing shared_structural_channel_ref -> RESULT_SCHEMA_NONCONFORMING), admits only n=2 while declaring maximum UNBOUNDED (3 participants -> INVALID_PARTICIPANT_SET), and does not materialize TD_R03's F2 grain.
V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build does not enforce the frozen family set; a hand-built rule with semantic_family='V556_INVENTED_FAMILY' is published in populated_families. Probe P4.

ADMITTED_OBJECTIVE_ROLES silently drops OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEX/OBJECTIVE_POSITION/OBJECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY that adopted M3 supports and its 29-test court proves; OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED is accepted but unsatisfiable. Probes P3, P10b.
one-rule-per-family is lawful and registry-local (P5/P14) but undocumented in material and its court proof exercises the duplicate-KEY branch instead of the family branch (P5b).

VALID_EMPTY_NO_GOVERNED_RULE is adopted terminology and the empty registry manufactures nothing, but the adopted seam reports UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY for the no-governed-rule case, collapsing TD_R03 section 12's required distinction. Pre-existing seam behaviour.
material is not frozen: MappingProxyType is imported and unused; deep mutation after authoring registers stale-hash material (P16).

the 13-property denominator is self-authored; six of seventeen tests assert constants of self-authored material; test 4 line 205 is a tautology; test 16 line 416 is vacuous via a misspelled family name; tests 12 and 14 prove the canaries, not the machinery.

required_repairs.action: validate schema and recompute schema_ref inside author_result_contract_binding; re-validate the embedded contract in author_governed_rule and V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build so unlawful material cannot reach GOVERNED_RULES_PRESENT
constrain participant_roles at authoring against a declared vocabulary, or remove the actor-semantic promise from the module docstring and the owner matrix

replace the relation-kind vocabulary so no governed kind is a TD_R03 section 5 / G14 forbidden premise; if H-B's coexistence array is retained, its elements must carry governed relation kinds plus cardinality/direction/symmetry
make the topology canary's declared maximum truthful or generalise it; disclose any single illustrative topology as such; reconcile with TD_R03 section 8's F2 grain

enforce the frozen family set in the registry; document the ADMITTED_OBJECTIVE_ROLES narrowing as tranche-local; support or remove OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED; record the one-rule-per-family restriction as named data

repair the court: exercise the family branch, fix the PREREQUISITE spelling, remove the tautology at test 4 line 205, and add machinery-level refusal tests for open schemas, person-state roles, actor-semantic role labels, strong-noun enums, numeric leaves and OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED
use MappingProxyType or immutable copies (or drop the import); freeze multiplicity_policy to a named enum

what_this_review_does_not_claim: No real-world structural claim of any kind is made or refuted; the canaries are machinery material.
No claim that the adopted M3 seam is defective; it fails closed on every hostile construction attempted and was not modified.

No claim that authoring a generic closed-schema builder must itself police enum vocabulary; the finding is that the substrate's DOCUMENTED and COURT-CLAIMED exclusions are instance-local, not machinery-level.
next_step_for_HQ: Adjudicate the disposition. If repair is authorized, R1-R4 are the load-bearing repairs (authoring-time refusal, actor-label/ontology gating, relation-kind vocabulary against TD_R03 G14, truthful/generic topology canary); R5-R7 are bounded robustness and court-quality repairs. No attractor population is authorized by this review.
